approach: Eliminate time between the x and y equations to get y directly in terms of x.

steps.text: Write the given x and y coordinates as functions of time.
Solve the x equation for time.
Substitute this time into the y equation and simplify.

common_mistakes.text: Substituting t = x/2 into 16t² as 16(x/2) instead of squaring the whole bracket gives y = 5x − 8x = −3x, a wrong linear equation.
